candidates.source_only_case: For base 1 m, rise 100000 m and storey height 200000 m, all finite and exactly representable as f32, top is 100001 m and there is one interval. The interval ratio exceeds 65535 by a wide margin, so the Rust float-to-u16 cast saturates to 65535. The positive-base entrance adds 1: with overflow checks enabled this addition panics; with checks disabled it wraps to 0. In the latter case a zero authored tread_count passes checked_sub against that wrapped result and the following source loop computes a 65535-tread interval. No product float, constructor, compiler profile, file or runtime was executed.
